bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears (4-2) are preparing for a Thursday Night Football matchup against the New England Patriots at Soldier Field, coming off an impressive Week 6 road win over the Falcons that saw quarterback Caleb Williams return from injury to earn NFC Offensive Player of the Week honors. However, the Bears will be without running back Kyle Monangai, who is dealing with turf toe , while right guard Jonah Jackson is set to play despite nagging hip and quadriceps issues.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: Detroit Lions safety Kerby Joseph posted a workout video showing encouraging progress in his recovery from a knee injury, continuing positive momentum after head coach Dan Campbell recently said the All-Pro safety is expected to play at some point this season. Detroit Lions safety Kerby Joseph posted a workout video that shows encouraging progress from his knee injury, and although there's still no return timeline, on Tuesday Dan Campbell said he still expects Joseph to play at some point this season before Joseph himself posted the optimistic update.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers released their Week 7 injury report Wednesday with several key players, including quarterback Jordan Love and wide receivers Christian Watson and Matthew Golden, all appearing on the injury report with limited practice participation labels ahead of their matchup against the Detroit Lions. Meanwhile, offensive coordinator Adam Stenavich expressed frustration over the ongoing uncertainty surrounding left guard Aaron Banks' injury recovery, wanting an end to the roller coaster as Green Bay prepares to face the Detroit Lions in Week 7 .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings received a major injury-report boost coming out of their bye week, as Jordan Addison, Christian Darrisaw, T.J. Hockenson and Jordan Mason, who all missed the team's last game, fully practiced Wednesday in their first session out of the bye.
